This name can be interpreted as 'Divine labor' or 'Divine toil' as the mother shines in her role. Another interpretation is 'Mother of light' or 'Mother of shining light'. The name Emmuela carries the meaning “Divine labor, toil, or emma (mother) + helle (light)” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
